requirements: Provide POST /conversions accepting JSON fields category, value, fromUnit, and toUnit, and return JSON fields result and unit. Support lowercase length units meter and centimeter and temperature units celsius and fahrenheit.
External clients access the API over HTTPS.
The server does not retain application data.
High availability is not required; deploy exactly one application VM.
Use Java 21, Spring Boot, Gradle, and Docker.
Expose GET /health and listen on application port 8080.
cloudConstraints: Deploy to Azure Korea Central on a Linux VM. The monthly infrastructure budget is 100 USD. One availability zone is acceptable. Terraform must provision or explicitly reference every required cloud resource.
